descriptionChirho: Adverb denoting the interior of something or motion from the interior outward, used both of physical interiors (Matt 23:25 'inside they are full of greed', Rev 4:8 'covered with eyes inside') and metaphorical inward character (Matt 23:27-28 'inwardly full of hypocrisy', Mark 7:21 'from within come evil thoughts'). Multilingual evidence: eng 'inside/from-within/within/inwardly', spa 'por-dentro/de-adentro/de-dentro', hin 'bheetar-se/andar', arb 'min-dakhilin', kor 'an-eseo/aneun', swa 'ndani/kutoka-ndani'. All three clusters share the same interior-location semantics with minor contextual variation in directionality.
